name: otp-share-guard
title: OTP Share Guard
description: Stops people reading a one-time code out to a scammer by saying in one sentence what it really approves ("This code approves a ₹24,999 payment to Croma", "This code logs in a new device"), and, when the app knows a call or screen share is active or the code is for a different action than the user started, switching to a strong never-share warning with press-and-hold to see the code, a delayed Copy, a code that is never drawn while the screen is shared, and a one-tap "I didn't request this".

meta.stops: OTP read out to a scammer
